source_findings: EIA 2023 U.S. net generation table, https://www.eia.gov/tools/faqs/faq.php?id=427&t=3, source eia-generation-2023, offsets 557 to 1157. Photovoltaic row gives 162 billion kWh and 3.9%, retained with correct sign, period and denominator.
